# **ADCOTE™**: One Global Brand for Flexible Materials

**The Right Performance. Right Where You Are.**

Bostik unifies its laminating adhesives and coatings portfolio under ADCOTE™, delivering reliable,
fit‑for‑purpose solutions worldwide.

[ Explore the portfolio ][65]
[Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch representing adhesives and coatings
solutions for flexible materials.] Bostik ADCOTE™ visual showing a flexible packaging pouch
representing adhesives and coatings solutions for flexible materials.

# Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene

Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive
designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling
efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation
supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals.

[ Discover the innovation ][66]
[A person holding an open plastic food container filled with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a
glowing edge highlighting the packaging.] A person holding an open plastic food container filled
with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a glowing edge highlighting the packaging.

# Empowering **local communities** to create lasting impact

Bostik proudly launches its Community Grant Programme to empower impactful local initiatives around
the world. By supporting community organizations and local partners, the programme helps bring
sustainable, meaningful projects to life, strengthening connections, fostering collaboration, and
creating lasting positive change where it matters most.

[ Discover the programme ][67]
[A Bostik representative addressing a group of participants during a community event held outdoors.]

# **ADCOTE™**: One Global Brand for Flexible Materials

**The Right Performance. Right Where You Are.**

Bostik unifies its laminating adhesives and coatings portfolio under ADCOTE™, delivering reliable,

# Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene

Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive
designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling
efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation
supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals.

## Ceresana – Ihr Partner für Marktforschung

### Marktstudien

Mit fundierter Fach- und Methodenkompetenz schafft Ceresana umfassende Markttransparenz. Mehr als
10.000 Kunden aus über 60 Ländern nutzen unsere Analysen, um Märkte besser zu verstehen, Chancen zu
erkennen und dem Wettbewerb einen Schritt voraus zu sein.

Unsere Marktstudien liefern direkt nutzbare Daten und Analysen zu Marktgröße, Nachfrage, Umsatz,
Anwendungen, Produkten, Regionen, Wettbewerbern, Preisen, Trends und Prognosen. Sie unterstützen
strategische Planung, Produktmanagement, Geschäftsentwicklung und Investitionsentscheidungen.

Besonders relevant für:

**Unternehmen & Hersteller**
Marktgröße, Nachfrageentwicklung, Anwendungen, regionale Chancen und Wettbewerb.

**Vertrieb, Marketing & Produktmanagement**
Kundenbranchen, Produktgruppen, Zielsegmente und Wachstumspotenziale.

**Investoren & Entscheider**
Marktattraktivität, Wachstumsannahmen und zukünftige Entwicklungsszenarien.

### Auftragsstudien & kundenspezifische Marktforschung

Ceresana unterstützt Unternehmen, Start-ups, Investoren, Forschungseinrichtungen und Konsortien mit
maßgeschneiderten Marktstudien für fundierte Markt-, Strategie-, Investitions- und
Kommerzialisierungsentscheidungen.

Wir analysieren Marktpotenziale, Wettbewerbsumfelder, Wertschöpfungsketten, Zielsegmente,
Anwendungen, Preise, Trends, Prognosen und Business Cases – zugeschnitten auf Ihre konkrete
Fragestellung und Entscheidungssituation.

Besonders relevant für:

**Unternehmen & Start-ups**
Markteintritt, Produktentwicklung, Skalierung, Go-to-Market und Business-Case-Validierung.

**Investoren & M&A-Teams**
Commercial Due Diligence, Marktvalidierung, Zielmarktanalyse und Exit-Unterstützung.

**Forschung, Hochschulen & Konsortien**
Marktlogik, Impact, Exploitation, Dissemination und Kommerzialisierungsstrategien.

### Bioökonomie-Events

Ceresanas Online-Events zur Bioökonomie bieten Fachwissen, aktuelle Markteinblicke, dynamische
Paneldiskussionen und gezieltes Networking mit relevanten Akteuren aus Industrie, Forschung,
Finanzierung und Innovation.

Unsere Events schaffen Sichtbarkeit und Austausch rund um biobasierte Materialien,
Kreislaufwirtschaft, nachhaltige Verpackungen, biobasierte Chemikalien, Klebstoffe, Kunststoffe,
industrielle Biotechnologie, KI, Digitalisierung und neue Geschäftsmodelle.

**Unternehmen & Start-ups**
Sichtbarkeit, Markteinblicke, Kooperationsmöglichkeiten und Investorenkontakte.

## Praxisbeispiel: Messbare Erfolge mit der Studie

### [Success Story: Genauer hinsehen in einem volatilen Umfeld][69]

*Wie ein weltweit tätiges Energieunternehmen strategische Einblicke in den europäischen Rohrmarkt
erlangte*

Ein europäischer Business Development Manager eines der führenden Energieunternehmen in Westeuropa
sah sich mit der Herausforderung konfrontiert, einen klaren und akkuraten Überblick über
Nachfrageschwankungen in der zunehmend volatilen Kunststoffrohrbranche zu behalten. Um den sich
wandelnden Markttrends einen Schritt voraus zu sein, wählte das Unternehmen einen datenbasierten
Ansatz. Diese Strategie beinhaltete den Erwerb der Marktstudie „Kunststoffrohre – Europa“, um
tiefere Einblicke in regionale Nachfragetrends und Anwendungsdynamiken zu gewinnen.

Aufgrund seiner Schlüsselrolle im Infrastruktur- und Bausektor wurde der Fokus auf den
Kunststoffrohrmarkt gelegt. Angesichts seiner Größe und Bedeutung verfolgen die Akteure der Branche
die Marktentwicklungen sehr genau, um über die wichtigsten Trends und Veränderungen informiert zu
bleiben.

Mithilfe der detaillierten Marktdaten aus der Studie konnte das Unternehmen wichtige Veränderungen
in lokalen Nachfragemustern identifizieren. Ein besonders wertvoller Aspekt war dabei die
länderspezifische Aufschlüsselung der Daten: „Insbesondere die Marktdaten pro Land haben uns dabei
geholfen, lokale Nachfragedynamiken zu erkennen, welche von den Durchschnittstrends auf
gesamteuropäischer Ebene abweichen.“

Indem das Unternehmen diese Erkenntnisse in seine Marktstrategie integrierte, erreichte es
erfolgreich sein Ziel, gut informierte Entscheidungen in einem sich rasch verändernden Umfeld zu
treffen. Die umfassende Evaluation der Marktentwicklungen lieferte eine solide Grundlage für die
strategische Planung, wodurch das Unternehmen Schwankungen innerhalb der Branche mit größerer
Zuversicht navigieren konnte. Mit einem klareren Verständnis der regionalen Nachfragetrends konnte
das Unternehmen einen gezielteren und proaktiveren Ansatz verfolgen und damit die
Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und die Bereitschaft für zukünftige Marktentwicklungen sicherstellen.

Ansatz. Diese Strategie beinhaltete den Erwerb der Marktstudie „Kunststoffrohre – Europa“, um
tiefere Einblicke in regionale Nachfragetrends und Anwendungsdynamiken zu gewinnen.

Aufgrund seiner Schlüsselrolle im Infrastruktur- und Bausektor wurde der Fokus auf den
Kunststoffrohrmarkt gelegt. Angesichts seiner Größe und Bedeutung verfolgen die Akteure der Branche
die Marktentwicklungen sehr genau, um über die wichtigsten Trends und Veränderungen informiert zu
bleiben.

Mithilfe der detaillierten Marktdaten aus der Studie konnte das Unternehmen wichtige Veränderungen
in lokalen Nachfragemustern identifizieren. Ein besonders wertvoller Aspekt war dabei die
länderspezifische Aufschlüsselung der Daten: „Insbesondere die Marktdaten pro Land haben uns dabei
geholfen, lokale Nachfragedynamiken zu erkennen, welche von den Durchschnittstrends auf
gesamteuropäischer Ebene abweichen.“

Indem das Unternehmen diese Erkenntnisse in seine Marktstrategie integrierte, erreichte es
erfolgreich sein Ziel, gut informierte Entscheidungen in einem sich rasch verändernden Umfeld zu
treffen. Die umfassende Evaluation der Marktentwicklungen lieferte eine solide Grundlage für die
strategische Planung, wodurch das Unternehmen Schwankungen innerhalb der Branche mit größerer
Zuversicht navigieren konnte. Mit einem klareren Verständnis der regionalen Nachfragetrends konnte
das Unternehmen einen gezielteren und proaktiveren Ansatz verfolgen und damit die
Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und die Bereitschaft für zukünftige Marktentwicklungen sicherstellen.

services around the globe.

[ [Sitecore.Data.Items.MediaItem?.Alt] ][183] [Technology Centers][184]
Our Technology Centers of Excellence connect our adhesive technology and market experts to our
customers’ product design and development experts. Learn more about our technical application and
R&D facilities.
[Read more][185]
[ [Sitecore.Data.Items.MediaItem?.Alt] ][186] [Advantages of Industrial Adhesives in Manufacturing
Processes][187]
The circular economy will occupy many of the product innovations in manufacturing. The advantages of
these bonding technologies include lighter weight, cost-effectiveness, safety, and improved
production speed. Discover how industrial adhesives can help.

## Latest Press Releases

[
[Henkel logo on a rooftop in Duesseldorf.]
Jul 7, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel successfully closes acquisition of premium hair care brand OLAPLEX

Henkel has successfully completed the acquisition of premium hair care brand OLAPLEX. Following the
fulfillment of all closing conditions, including the required regulatory approvals, OLAPLEX is now
fully part of Henkel. This acquisition marks another important milestone in Henkel’s purposeful
growth agenda.

Learn more
][197]
[
[ Bergquist TGF 6500LVO, shown dispensed with both thin and thick bond lines.]
Jul 21, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel launches next-generation thermal gap filler with 6.5W/m∙K conductivity

Rising thermal loads in vehicle electronics are increasing the need for high-performance thermal
management solutions, especially in advanced applications such as ADAS, ECUs, or power conversion
components in electric vehicles. To address this fast-evolving challenge, Henkel Adhesive
Technologies has launched Bergquist Gap Filler TGF 6500LVO, a next-generation thermal gap filler
with 6.5W/m∙K thermal conductivity. This new material enables more effective heat transfer in
critical systems, helping manufacturers manage increasing power density and maintain performance and
reliability.

Learn more
][198]
[
[Three people at a book presentation event, with the person in the center holding a copy of a book
on Henkel’s corporate history.]
Jul 9, 2026 - Press Release
150 Years of Henkel’s History Presented in New Book

Henkel was founded in 1876 and celebrates its 150th anniversary this year – a special milestone that
draws attention to the company’s long and multifaceted history. In the run-up to this anniversary,
Prof. Dr. Joachim Scholtyseck, Professor of Modern and Contemporary History at the University of
Bonn, has conducted a comprehensive academic study of Henkel’s development over several years. In
his independent research, he traces the company’s evolution from a local laundry detergent
manufacturer to a publicly listed global company.

Learn more
][199]

adhesives.]
Jun 17, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel technology supports completion of the Sagrada Familia’s central towers
* The Sagrada Familia’s six central towers have been realized with the support of advanced Henkel
  adhesives, coinciding with the centenary of Gaudí’s death.
* The Sagrada Familia’s modular construction system, incorporating Henkel’s adhesive solution, has
  accelerated construction while ensuring long-term structural durability.

Jul 7, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel successfully closes acquisition of premium hair care brand OLAPLEX

Henkel has successfully completed the acquisition of premium hair care brand OLAPLEX. Following the
fulfillment of all closing conditions, including the required regulatory approvals, OLAPLEX is now
fully part of Henkel. This acquisition marks another important milestone in Henkel’s purposeful
growth agenda.

Jul 21, 2026 - Press Release
Henkel launches next-generation thermal gap filler with 6.5W/m∙K conductivity

Rising thermal loads in vehicle electronics are increasing the need for high-performance thermal
management solutions, especially in advanced applications such as ADAS, ECUs, or power conversion
components in electric vehicles. To address this fast-evolving challenge, Henkel Adhesive
Technologies has launched Bergquist Gap Filler TGF 6500LVO, a next-generation thermal gap filler
with 6.5W/m∙K thermal conductivity. This new material enables more effective heat transfer in
critical systems, helping manufacturers manage increasing power density and maintain performance and
reliability.

Learn more

Jul 9, 2026 - Press Release
150 Years of Henkel’s History Presented in New Book

Henkel was founded in 1876 and celebrates its 150th anniversary this year – a special milestone that
draws attention to the company’s long and multifaceted history. In the run-up to this anniversary,
Prof. Dr. Joachim Scholtyseck, Professor of Modern and Contemporary History at the University of
Bonn, has conducted a comprehensive academic study of Henkel’s development over several years. In
his independent research, he traces the company’s evolution from a local laundry detergent
manufacturer to a publicly listed global company.

Learn more

Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and
production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the
building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in
over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it
plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation
industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated
annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.

# One Total Building Enclosure System

The world’s leading construction material brands now provide a complete structure and continuous
building envelope from a single source.
[See how we do it][42]

## Tremco CPG Brands

Tremco Construction Products Group unites the industry's premier building and maintenance solutions
into one enclosure system that allows you to design, build, restore and maintain buildings faster,
safer and more efficiently.

[View all brands][43]
[Construction workers spray concrete into Nudura insulated concrete form building. ] [Construction
worker on phone in front of stone building]

#### Dryvit

Cladding, exterior wall panels, and continuous insulation systems for commercial and residential
construction. 
[Visit dryvit.com][44] [Dryvit logo]

#### Nudura

Insulated Concrete Forms (ICFs) and compatible accessories for building energy-efficient and
disaster-resilient structures.
[Visit nudura.com][45] [Nudura logo]

#### Tremco Roofing

Roof repair and restoration products and comprehensive building maintenance programs.
[Visit tremcoroofing.com][46] [Tremco Roofing logo]

#### Tremco Sealants

Sealant, air barrier, and waterproofing systems for new building construction and restoration,
modular, residential windows, and industrial applications. 
[Visit tremcosealants.com][47] [Tremco CSW logo]

## Our Approach: A 6-sided Building Solution

From the foundation to the roof, including the structural elements, insulation, cladding,
waterproofing, HVAC and more, Tremco CPG solutions and services ensure an air- and water-tight
building envelope.  
[Learn about the 6-sided solution][48]
[Puerto Rico Convention Center building with domed roof and glass façade restored using Tremco
glazing products.]

## Solutions for Any Application

Quickly find the products you need for your next project.
[

##### Building Envelope

Sealants, air barriers, waterproofing, and other building materials to weatherproof your structure.

][49]

##### Facades, Continuous Insulation, and Cladding

From continuous insulation, prefabricated wall panels and more, see our array of exterior building
solutions. 

##### Structural

Build better with exterior walls constructed with durable, insulated concrete forms.

##### Roof & HVAC Restoration & Repair

Systems to waterproof and beautify any commercial roof, as well as restore the building's units. 

##### Industrial

Sealants, gaskets, spacers, tapes and more for in-plant glazing, insulating glass units, modular,
and OEM applications. 

## Discover One  Warranty

Products from Tremco CPG companies are designed and tested to work as one continuous system — and
warranted together in a single document.
[See our warranties][50]

## Our Expertise

Restoration Offsite Construction Maintenance
[Aerial shot of a multi-story apartment building using beige Dryvit EIFS and red NewBrick exterior
cladding. ]

Fix roof and window leaks, restore a structure’s airtightness, enhance the exterior aesthetics, or
conduct a deep energy retrofit with Tremco CPG systems and customized support. [Learn more about
building restoration][51]
[Man in facemask uses trowel on Dryvit architectural shape in manufacturing facility ]

### Offsite Construction

Whether prefabricating wall components, panelizing the entire exterior cladding, or building entire

# One Total Building Enclosure System

The world’s leading construction material brands now provide a complete structure and continuous
building envelope from a single source.
[See how we do it][42]

## Tremco CPG Brands

Tremco Construction Products Group unites the industry's premier building and maintenance solutions
into one enclosure system that allows you to design, build, restore and maintain buildings faster,
safer and more efficiently.

[View all brands][43]
[Construction workers spray concrete into Nudura insulated concrete form building. ] [Construction
worker on phone in front of stone building]

#### Dryvit

Cladding, exterior wall panels, and continuous insulation systems for commercial and residential
construction. 
[Visit dryvit.com][44] [Dryvit logo]

#### Nudura

Insulated Concrete Forms (ICFs) and compatible accessories for building energy-efficient and
disaster-resilient structures.
[Visit nudura.com][45] [Nudura logo]

#### Tremco Roofing

Roof repair and restoration products and comprehensive building maintenance programs.
[Visit tremcoroofing.com][46] [Tremco Roofing logo]

#### Tremco Sealants

Sealant, air barrier, and waterproofing systems for new building construction and restoration,
modular, residential windows, and industrial applications. 
[Visit tremcosealants.com][47] [Tremco CSW logo]

## Our Approach: A 6-sided Building Solution

From the foundation to the roof, including the structural elements, insulation, cladding,
waterproofing, HVAC and more, Tremco CPG solutions and services ensure an air- and water-tight
building envelope.  
[Learn about the 6-sided solution][48]
[Puerto Rico Convention Center building with domed roof and glass façade restored using Tremco
glazing products.]

## Solutions for Any Application

Quickly find the products you need for your next project.
[

##### Building Envelope

Sealants, air barriers, waterproofing, and other building materials to weatherproof your structure.

][49]

##### Facades, Continuous Insulation, and Cladding

From continuous insulation, prefabricated wall panels and more, see our array of exterior building
solutions. 

##### Structural

Build better with exterior walls constructed with durable, insulated concrete forms.

##### Roof & HVAC Restoration & Repair

Systems to waterproof and beautify any commercial roof, as well as restore the building's units. 

##### Industrial

Sealants, gaskets, spacers, tapes and more for in-plant glazing, insulating glass units, modular,
and OEM applications. 

## Discover One  Warranty

Products from Tremco CPG companies are designed and tested to work as one continuous system — and
warranted together in a single document.
[See our warranties][50]

## Our Expertise

Restoration Offsite Construction Maintenance
[Aerial shot of a multi-story apartment building using beige Dryvit EIFS and red NewBrick exterior
cladding. ]

### Restoration

Fix roof and window leaks, restore a structure’s airtightness, enhance the exterior aesthetics, or
conduct a deep energy retrofit with Tremco CPG systems and customized support. [Learn more about
building restoration][51]
[Man in facemask uses trowel on Dryvit architectural shape in manufacturing facility ]

### Offsite Construction

Whether prefabricating wall components, panelizing the entire exterior cladding, or building entire
modular units, Tremco CPG can help with all your in-plant construction needs. [Discover Tremco’s
offsite solutions][52]
[Construction worker using Tremco’s RoofTec system to clean rooftop ]

### Maintenance

Maintain your building’s air and watertightness, indoor air quality, and aesthetics with Tremco’s
ongoing maintenance and asset management programs.  [See how our maintenance programs can help][53]

## Building Science and Testing

Ensure your building details will be leak-free with construction testing from Tremco CPG. Our
Building Science Laboratory can test full wall assemblies for air and moisture infiltration and
thermal conductivity, confirm building material compatibility, and measure a roof’s ability to
withstand high winds, rain, and fire. 
[See our assembly testing in action][54]
[Employees smiling in front of Tremco’s company garden]

### Our Values

We focus on safety, sustainability and industry engagement to help build structures that will
protect communities across the globe.
[Learn more about our values][55]
[Tremco vegetated roof next to glass building.]

### Sustainability

Our products and systems reduce waste, ensure a healthy environment, and build energy-efficient
structures. 
[Go green with Tremco][56]
[4 people at training demonstrating Tremco sealant and air barrier application.]

### Education and Training

Stay up to date with the latest construction trends and get trained on how to design and build with
our technologies.
[Explore our opportunities][57]

## Custom Design Simulator

Combine colors and textures for a unique parking garage, facade, balcony, or plaza deck!

[Get creative with our Building Visualizer][58]

# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

# All change at No 10: what we need to see from our next prime minister

The UK’s domestic priorities are inseparable from global realities. Our next prime minister must
recognise this and take decisive steps to rebuild trust, both with the UK public and international
partners.

[Read the blog][38]

## Who we are

‌Bond connects, strengthens and champions a dynamic network of civil society organisations to
eradicate global poverty, inequality and injustice.

[Find out more about us][39]

## What we do

Our advocacy work helps our members get their voices heard. We work in many different areas across
sustainable development and social change.

[Learn more about our work][40]

## Latest news & views

[ [Shifting the Power Comms Lab. Credit: Comic Relief] ][41] [News & views][42]

### [What do the British public really think about shifting the power?][43]

July 23, 2026[Ayesha Farah][44]

Comic Relief, along with the Development Engagement Lab, asked the British public who should lead
international development, and the answers suggest that genuine localisation is not only possible,
but wanted.

[ [UK Aid tents providing shelter for people who have lost their homes to Cyclone Idai in
Mozambique, in March 2019. Photograph: Rein Skullerud/WFP/Rein Skullerud] ][45] [News & views][46]

### [New FCDO Annual Report lays bare devastating cuts to the poorest and most fragile
### countries][47]

July 22, 2026[Lena Cohrs][48]

We now have a clear idea of where upcoming ODA cuts will fall – and it’s a brutal picture. Lena
Cohrs at Bond asks: Will the new Burnham government take the bold steps needed to get the UK’s
development ambitions back on track?

[ [Mosque, Minaret. Credit: musaabtr / Pixabay] ][49] [News & views][50]

### [Syria’s chance for a peaceful, inclusive future must not be wasted][51]

July 20, 2026[Gloria Leccese-Debney][52]

In Syria, there is a deep desire for fairness and justice, where all ethnic and religious
communities can live together in peace and dignity. The international community, including the UK,
must ensure the transitional government realise this vision.

# All change at No 10: what we need to see from our next prime minister

The UK’s domestic priorities are inseparable from global realities. Our next prime minister must
recognise this and take decisive steps to rebuild trust, both with the UK public and international
partners.

[Read the blog][38]

## Who we are

‌Bond connects, strengthens and champions a dynamic network of civil society organisations to
eradicate global poverty, inequality and injustice.

[Find out more about us][39]

## What we do

Our advocacy work helps our members get their voices heard. We work in many different areas across
sustainable development and social change.

[Learn more about our work][40]

## Latest news & views

[ [Shifting the Power Comms Lab. Credit: Comic Relief] ][41] [News & views][42]

### **Registration is open for the Fall 2026 ACI Concrete Convention in Atlanta, GA, USA**

Registration is now open for the Fall 2026 ACI Concrete Convention in Atlanta, GA, USA. Known as the
world’s gathering place for advancing concrete, the convention will take place October 11-14, 2026.
The official hotel for the ACI Concrete Convention is the Hilton Atlanta.

[Learn More »][131]


[[ACI, NEU release new certificate program]][132]

### **ACI, NEU release new certificate program for low-carbon concrete covering qualification,
### design, and compliance**

ACI University and NEU have released a new Certificate Program, Low-Carbon Concrete: Quantification,
Design, and Compliance. This new program is designed to educate participants on the principles,
tools, and practices used to understand, quantify, and reduce concrete’s embodied carbon.

[Learn More »][133]


[[ACIF Future Leaders]][134]

### **Help build tomorrow’s concrete leaders through research and education**

The ACI Foundation fuels innovation and strengthens the concrete industry by funding groundbreaking
research and empowering future leaders through scholarships and fellowships. By investing in
students, ideas, and collaboration, the Foundation helps keep the concrete industry at the forefront
of technological advances in material composition, design, and construction worldwide.

[Learn More »][135]


[[ACI Store]][136]

### **Why Purchasing from the ACI Store or Authorized Distribution Partners Matters**

ACI is committed to developing and publishing trusted consensus-based standards, technical
documents, and educational resources that support the safety, durability, and advancement of
concrete design and construction worldwide. Recently, fraudulent and unauthorized copies of ACI
documents have appeared on different, questionable websites. These counterfeit or illegally
distributed materials present serious risks to users and to the integrity of the industry.

# Dayton Superior | The Leading Provider of Engineered Construction Solutions for Over 100 years

### Why Dayton Superior?

From our 17,000 hard-working products to our 1200+ dedicated people, Dayton Superior is all about
building strength. As the leading single-source provider of [concrete accessories][227], [concrete
chemicals][228], and [concrete forming products][229] for the non-residential construction industry,
we deliver strong, proven products and build strong relationships built on integrity, responsiveness
and unwavering support.

 

[Learn More About Who We Are][230]

### Resources

### ENGINEERING SERVICES

******Engineered Solutions When There's No Margin for Error**

 

Dayton Superior engineers have the industry’s expertise in concrete construction, including
foundation types, commercial buildings, pre-cast and tilt-up projects.

Because you can’t afford even one mistake, our team will perform with precision throughout the
design, build and maintenance stages of your project.

 

[View Engineering Services][231]

### TRAINING CLASSES & VIDEOS

********

******Let Our Knowledge Build Yours**

 

Dayton Superior training is a powerful, cost-effective way to stay current with products,
technology, safety and trends.

Our industry pros share their expertise through engaging presentations, hands-on practice, classes,
demonstrations and AIA continuing education.

 

[VIEW TRAINING RESOURCES][232]

# Dayton Superior | The Leading Provider of Engineered Construction Solutions for Over 100 years

### Why Dayton Superior?

From our 17,000 hard-working products to our 1200+ dedicated people, Dayton Superior is all about
building strength. As the leading single-source provider of [concrete accessories][227], [concrete
chemicals][228], and [concrete forming products][229] for the non-residential construction industry,
we deliver strong, proven products and build strong relationships built on integrity, responsiveness
and unwavering support.

 

[Learn More About Who We Are][230]

### Resources

### ENGINEERING SERVICES

******Engineered Solutions When There's No Margin for Error**

 

Dayton Superior engineers have the industry’s expertise in concrete construction, including
foundation types, commercial buildings, pre-cast and tilt-up projects.

Because you can’t afford even one mistake, our team will perform with precision throughout the
design, build and maintenance stages of your project.

 

[View Engineering Services][231]

### TRAINING CLASSES & VIDEOS

********

******Let Our Knowledge Build Yours**

 

Dayton Superior training is a powerful, cost-effective way to stay current with products,
technology, safety and trends.

Our industry pros share their expertise through engaging presentations, hands-on practice, classes,
demonstrations and AIA continuing education.

 

[VIEW TRAINING RESOURCES][232]

you source wholesale merchandise from **UK suppliers** faster than ever before.

Basic wholesale buyer membership is free, with the option of [upgrading to premium buyer
services][149] to access all listed supplier and wholesaler details. If you are a UK wholesale
supplier you can [list your business details free][150] and upgrade to premium services, which
include a number of trade tools that will increase your company's exposure to wholesale buyers
worldwide.

Thousands of trade buyers and wholesale UK suppliers are [joining eSources][151] every month, be
part of this growing trend and start profiting from our services.

* **Subscribe to Premium Buyer Membership** to get access to thousands of exclusive wholesale
  sources and websites.

#### For Trade Suppliers
* Are you a wholesaler or trade supplier? **Request a free listing** on eSources
* **Register for Premium Supplier Membership** and increase your business and products visibility to
  buyers worldwide.
* List products, receive orders, and reply to buy leads.
* Track your advertising performance
* Receive alerts on new buy requests
* List your company profile in up to 5 categories and target each profile to each category.
* Stay ahead of your competition.

#### Resources
* Access hundreds of [auction houses][154] and discover the latest clearance auctions in the UK
* Read [trade related articles][155] and enhance your sales skills.
* Research the selling potential of any product using the free eSources [Market Research
  Wizard][156].

#### New Wholesale Products

#### Register on eSources as a buyer, premium supplier or international supplier:

As a **B2B trade portal** we offer 4 registration options. If you are a retailer or trade buyer
looking to source **wholesale products**, stocklots or clearance lines from UK suppliers and
**wholesalers**, select the Trade Buyers registration option. **UK based suppliers, wholesalers,
importers, distributors and manufacturers** looking to reach trade buyers worldwide can list their
business using our **premium services**. If your business is based abroad but supplies to the UK
please use the [international supplier registration option][157]. Premium suppliers, wholesalers,
importers and manufacturers benefit from increased exposure and numerous trading tools to increase
sales:

* Free access to all premium suppliers

Basic wholesale buyer membership is free, with the option of [upgrading to premium buyer
services][149] to access all listed supplier and wholesaler details. If you are a UK wholesale
supplier you can [list your business details free][150] and upgrade to premium services, which
include a number of trade tools that will increase your company's exposure to wholesale buyers
worldwide.

Thousands of trade buyers and wholesale UK suppliers are [joining eSources][151] every month, be
part of this growing trend and start profiting from our services.

#### Register on eSources as a buyer, premium supplier or international supplier:

looking to source **wholesale products**, stocklots or clearance lines from UK suppliers and

importers, distributors and manufacturers** looking to reach trade buyers worldwide can list their
business using our **premium services**. If your business is based abroad but supplies to the UK
please use the [international supplier registration option][157]. Premium suppliers, wholesalers,
importers and manufacturers benefit from increased exposure and numerous trading tools to increase
sales:

### Innovation Hub

To build on its vision of cutting-edge manufacturing, Guelph-based Linamar recently constructed the
Linamar Innovation Hub. From conception through to design and build, the facility needed to
accommodate the dynamic nature of the company’s business. Research, development, and
contract-manufacturing require a facility that can withstand constant re-tooling and rearrangement
of heavy equipment. This created the necessity for a particularly resilient concrete floor.

[Whitby Health Centre]

### Whitby Health Centre

For the construction of a new Health Clinic in Whitby, the contractor reached out to Form & Build to
procure many of the items needed to complete all of the concrete work. Everything from Grief forming
tubes to Krystaline Plug from Kryton to effectively patch tie holes were supplied according the
project timeline. Originally, the contractor intended to cure the building footings using standard
burlap for a wet cure. While a wet cure with burlap has its advantages, it requires daily watering
to achieve an effective cure. This process is time consuming and may be forgotten for a day or two
on a busy job site. This ultimately can lead to a substandard and weaker concrete slab.

will be a vibrant part of Hamilton. However, the General Contractor entrusted with construction of
the new headquarters found that the site’s close proximity to Hamilton Harbour posed a challenge.
Ground water and hydrostatic pressure were significant at the site and had the contractor exploring
dependable foundational waterproofing solutions.

[Innovation Hub]

### Innovation Hub

To build on its vision of cutting-edge manufacturing, Guelph-based Linamar recently constructed the
Linamar Innovation Hub. From conception through to design and build, the facility needed to
accommodate the dynamic nature of the company’s business. Research, development, and
contract-manufacturing require a facility that can withstand constant re-tooling and rearrangement
of heavy equipment. This created the necessity for a particularly resilient concrete floor.

View Project
[Whitby Health Centre]

### Whitby Health Centre

For the construction of a new Health Clinic in Whitby, the contractor reached out to Form & Build to
procure many of the items needed to complete all of the concrete work. Everything from Grief forming
tubes to Krystaline Plug from Kryton to effectively patch tie holes were supplied according the
project timeline. Originally, the contractor intended to cure the building footings using standard
burlap for a wet cure. While a wet cure with burlap has its advantages, it requires daily watering
to achieve an effective cure. This process is time consuming and may be forgotten for a day or two
on a busy job site. This ultimately can lead to a substandard and weaker concrete slab.

View Project
[Effort Trust]

### Effort Trust

Situated in picturesque Gore Park in downtown Hamilton, Effort Trust’s new headquarters will be part
of the area’s revitalization. With new condos, retail, and office space, the area around Gore Park
will be a vibrant part of Hamilton. However, the General Contractor entrusted with construction of
the new headquarters found that the site’s close proximity to Hamilton Harbour posed a challenge.
Ground water and hydrostatic pressure were significant at the site and had the contractor exploring
dependable foundational waterproofing solutions.

View Project

New Henkel automotive adhesive: one product, twice the power

Henkel has introduced the Teroson EP 52 Series, a structural adhesive for increased structural
integrity, durability and vibration damping capability. Teroson High Damping Structural Adhesive
‏(HDSA) emerges as a game changer in the realm of structural adhesives. Beyond its exceptional
bonding capabilities, this heat-curing, solvent-free, one-component adhesive boasts unique damping
characteristics that redefine the landscape of adhesive performance.

The Problem

## Procurement doesn't capture the value already sitting in it's existing portfolio...

01 — The reality
Data scattered across multiple systems

Spreadsheets on shared drives. Records in SAP, Oracle, Coupa. Contacts in Outlook. The same supplier
exists three times under three names.

02 — The consequence
No transparency on what you have

You can’t search what you can’t see. Capabilities and risk signals exist in fragments — never as one
queryable picture of your portfolio.

03 — The blind spot
Hidden potential in portfolio and markets

You source new suppliers for capabilities you already have. Existing partners are passed over
because nobody knows what they can do.

04 — The cost
Missed opportunities and market changes

Every new initiative starts from a partial view. Decisions miss the alternatives you never knew
existed.

team is committed to helping you find the right tools for your job. Explore our broad selection of
industrial tools for sale today.

When it comes to sourcing industrial supplies in Melbourne, POPS Industrial offers unmatched
experience and customer service. With over six decades of operation, we understand the diverse needs
of our customers, from large multinational companies to local tradespeople.

Our industrial supplies come from trusted manufacturers, ensuring top-quality and reliable tools.

commitment to customer satisfaction and competitive pricing makes us the preferred supplier for all
your **[industrial tool ][130]** needs.

At POPS Industrial, we offer a wide selection of industrial supplies in Melbourne for construction,
engineering and manufacturing. Whether you are looking for power tools, safety equipment or
fasteners, we offer the best products to meet your business needs.

Our range of power, cordless and air tools ensures you can tackle any project efficiently. From
drills and saws to pneumatic tools, we offer the heavy-duty equipment you need to make your tasks
easier and more productive.

We also stock bearings and fasteners that meet the highest performance standards, ensuring that your
machinery and equipment run smoothly. Whether you need roller bearings or precision fasteners, we

# Protective.
# Emotive.
# Demand both.

From automotive and aerospace to coil and specialty, we engineer coatings and surface solutions that
protect and inspire.

[ About us ][60]

Image

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

[ Press Release ][62]

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

[ Careers ][64]

### Merging science and beauty

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

[ About us ][65]

### Reliable worldwide

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

## What we do

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.

Image

### Automotive

Our solutions support a broad range of vehicle categories and powertrain concepts, helping
manufacturers, suppliers, body builders and bodyshops create the surfaces that keep the automotive
world moving.

With decades of aerospace experience and a broad portfolio of OEM approved technologies, we support
a wide range of aircraft types and applications.
[Learn more][70]
[
Image
[detail of steel coils in warehouse] ][71]

### Coil

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[
Image
[motorcycles parked in row in various colors] ][73]

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.
[Learn more][74]

From the world's most advanced color expertise to award-winning sustainable innovation, these are
some of the capabilities that make us a partner unlike any other.

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026
[[Image of the executive committee of Surventis] ][85]

### [ BASF Coatings names Executive Committee to lead and drive success as a standalone company
### ][86]

MUENSTER, Germany, June 25, 2026. BASF Coatings today named the leadership team that will run the
business as an independent company from July 1, 2026, after the closing of the transaction. The new
structure brings together leaders who have built the coatings business over many years and senior
executives with proven records in finance, digital and transformation. The Executive Committee will
be led by incoming Chief Executive Officer Jens Luehring.

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in

# Commercial Caulking & Joint Sealant in Toledo

Replacement of failed exterior joint sealants on commercial buildings: precast and panel joints,
window and curtain wall perimeters, expansion joints, and control joints in masonry. The building
envelope work that stops water before it reaches interiors.

[Get a quote Takes about a minute][7] [How this works →][8]

We are still finalising the local company for this trade. Send your project and we will route it as
soon as that is set.

## Get a quote on your project

Tell us what you need. We pass it to the local company we work with, usually the same business day.

Leave this blank
Your name
Phone Email
Property ZIP or address What do you need done? Send my request

Give us a phone number or an email so someone can reach you. By sending this you agree we may share
it with the local company that does this work so they can contact you about the project. We do not
sell your information. Not for emergencies — call 911.

The short version

## Commercial Caulking & Joint Sealant, explained

Joint sealant is a wear item with a service life, not a permanent part of the building. Polyurethane
typically gives seven to ten years outdoors; high-performance silicone commonly reaches fifteen to
twenty. When it goes, water enters at the joint and travels, so the interior stain is rarely under
the failure. That gap between where water gets in and where it shows up is why sealant work starts
with a survey rather than a tube of caulk.

Most of the cost is access and removal, not material. Getting a mechanic to a joint eight floors up
on a swing stage or boom is the expensive part, and cutting the old sealant out cleanly takes longer
than gunning the new one in. That economics has a practical consequence for a building owner: once
rigging is up, doing the full elevation costs much less per foot than coming back next year for the
joints that were left.

Commercial Caulking & Joint Sealant — typical work profile.

### Joint survey and testing

Elevations walked or dropped, joint types and widths recorded, and adhesion pull tests done on the
existing sealant. This determines which joints are failing and what the replacement product has to
bond to.

### Full removal of old sealant

Existing sealant cut out to the substrate on both faces and the joint cleaned. Residue left behind
is the most common cause of a new sealant failing early.

### Backer rod and bond breaker

Closed-cell or open-cell rod installed to set joint depth and prevent the sealant bonding to the
back of the joint. Bond breaker tape used where the joint is too shallow for rod.

### Priming and sealant installation

Substrate primed where the manufacturer requires it, then sealant gunned and tooled in one pass to
full contact on both faces at the specified width-to-depth ratio.

### Adhesion mock-up and field testing

A test section installed and pull-tested before the full run, then spot tests during the work. This
is standard on specified projects and worth requesting on any large elevation.

### Water testing and leak tracing

Spray testing suspect areas to confirm the leak path before and after work. Necessary when the
complaint is an interior leak rather than visibly failed joints.

Budgeting

## What it costs

Per-foot rates assume reachable joints and normal removal. Rigging, swing stage or boom rental,
mobilization, sidewalk protection, and permits are usually separate line items and on a tall
building can exceed the sealant work itself. Published sources vary widely because they assume
different access, so treat these as a budget frame. A real number comes after a joint survey and
adhesion testing. Typical values are interpolated between published low and high figures.

Typical ranges, per linear foot of joint (cut out old sealant, prep, backer rod, new sealant). The
dot marks where most projects land; the bar is the full spread we found. These are planning figures,
not a quote.

Reviewed 2026-07-19.

Toledo specifics

## What is different about this work in Toledo

Local climate and building stock change how this job is specified. These figures come from the
Census Bureau and NOAA climate normals for Toledo.
* With roughly 81.9 freeze-thaw cycles a year, water sitting behind a joint that has let go on one
  face expands inside the substrate, so failures here tend to take masonry and precast edges with
  them rather than staying a sealant problem.
* Most joint sealants have a minimum application temperature near 40 degrees, so with January lows
  around 18.4 degrees, cold-season work needs a low-temperature-rated product and dry, frost-free
  joints, not just a warm afternoon in the forecast.

[More on local conditions →][11]

Scoping

## Do you actually need this done?

The most expensive mistake is paying for the wrong scope. Here is how the usual symptoms sort out.

Common starting points. An on-site look is what settles it.

Process

## How the job runs
1. ### Survey and product selection
   
   Joints inspected and measured, substrates identified, and adhesion tested. Product is selected
   for movement capability and substrate compatibility, not for what is on the truck.
2. ### Mock-up and approval
   
   A sample run installed, cured, and hand pull-tested to confirm adhesion and primer requirements.
   Color is approved against the wall in daylight since cured color differs from the tube.
3. ### Access setup and protection
   
   Lift, stage, or rope access rigged, and sidewalks, glass, and landscaping protected. Tenants near
   the work get notice, particularly where windows must stay closed.
4. ### Cut out and clean
   
   Old sealant removed to sound substrate on both faces, joints cleaned by grinding or a two-cloth
   solvent wipe, and dust blown out. Joints are sealed the same day they are prepped.
5. ### Rod, prime, gun, and tool
   
   Backer rod set to depth, primer applied where required, sealant gunned and tooled to full contact
   on both joint faces. Tooling is what forces the hourglass profile that lets the joint move.
6. ### Cure, test, and close out
   
   Sealant cures for the product's stated period, then spot adhesion checks and any water testing.
   Close-out should include product data sheets, warranty documents, and a marked-up elevation of
   what was replaced.

Common questions

## Questions people ask

How often does commercial caulking need to be replaced?

It depends on the product. Standard polyurethane joint sealant typically gives seven to ten years in
exterior service. High-performance silicone commonly reaches fifteen to twenty. Exposure matters:
south and west elevations and joints in full sun fail first. Rather than replacing on a calendar,
most owners survey the envelope every few years and act when adhesion testing shows joints letting
go.

How much does it cost to recaulk a commercial building?

Published per-foot rates run roughly $4 to $12 for exterior wall joint replacement, $7 to $18 for
expansion joints, and $10 to $16 for window perimeters at elevated access. Total cost depends far
more on access than on footage: rigging a swing stage or renting a boom for a tall elevation can
exceed the sealant line. A real number requires a joint survey.

Can you caulk over old caulk?

Not on exterior joints that matter. New sealant can only be as sound as what it bonds to, and old
sealant that is failing takes the new layer with it. Proper replacement means cutting the old
material out to the substrate on both joint faces and cleaning the surfaces. Anyone quoting a
caulk-over on a building envelope is quoting a short-term cosmetic fix.

Silicone or polyurethane for building joints?

Silicone handles more movement, resists sunlight far better, and lasts longer, which is why it
dominates high-movement and glazing perimeter joints. Polyurethane is paintable, less prone to
staining porous stone, and cheaper. Choice comes down to expected joint movement, substrate, whether
the joint gets painted, and whether staining is a risk. A survey should name the product and the
reason.

Why did my new caulking fail so fast?

Usually one of four things: the old sealant was not fully removed, the substrate was not cleaned or
primed, no backer rod was used so the sealant bonded on three sides and could not stretch, or a
product with too little movement capability was chosen for the joint. All four look identical on day
one, which is why adhesion mock-ups and pull testing exist.

Replacement of failed exterior joint sealants on commercial buildings: precast and panel joints,
window and curtain wall perimeters, expansion joints, and control joints in masonry. The building
envelope work that stops water before it reaches interiors.

The short version

## Commercial Caulking & Joint Sealant, explained

Joint sealant is a wear item with a service life, not a permanent part of the building. Polyurethane
typically gives seven to ten years outdoors; high-performance silicone commonly reaches fifteen to
twenty. When it goes, water enters at the joint and travels, so the interior stain is rarely under
the failure. That gap between where water gets in and where it shows up is why sealant work starts
with a survey rather than a tube of caulk.

Most of the cost is access and removal, not material. Getting a mechanic to a joint eight floors up
on a swing stage or boom is the expensive part, and cutting the old sealant out cleanly takes longer
than gunning the new one in. That economics has a practical consequence for a building owner: once
rigging is up, doing the full elevation costs much less per foot than coming back next year for the
joints that were left.

Commercial Caulking & Joint Sealant — typical work profile.

### Joint survey and testing

Elevations walked or dropped, joint types and widths recorded, and adhesion pull tests done on the
existing sealant. This determines which joints are failing and what the replacement product has to
bond to.

### Full removal of old sealant

Existing sealant cut out to the substrate on both faces and the joint cleaned. Residue left behind
is the most common cause of a new sealant failing early.

### Backer rod and bond breaker

Closed-cell or open-cell rod installed to set joint depth and prevent the sealant bonding to the
back of the joint. Bond breaker tape used where the joint is too shallow for rod.

### Priming and sealant installation

Substrate primed where the manufacturer requires it, then sealant gunned and tooled in one pass to
full contact on both faces at the specified width-to-depth ratio.

### Adhesion mock-up and field testing

A test section installed and pull-tested before the full run, then spot tests during the work. This
is standard on specified projects and worth requesting on any large elevation.

### Water testing and leak tracing

Spray testing suspect areas to confirm the leak path before and after work. Necessary when the
complaint is an interior leak rather than visibly failed joints.

Budgeting

## What it costs

Per-foot rates assume reachable joints and normal removal. Rigging, swing stage or boom rental,
mobilization, sidewalk protection, and permits are usually separate line items and on a tall
building can exceed the sealant work itself. Published sources vary widely because they assume
different access, so treat these as a budget frame. A real number comes after a joint survey and
adhesion testing. Typical values are interpolated between published low and high figures.

Toledo specifics

## What is different about this work in Toledo

Local climate and building stock change how this job is specified. These figures come from the
Census Bureau and NOAA climate normals for Toledo.
* With roughly 81.9 freeze-thaw cycles a year, water sitting behind a joint that has let go on one
  face expands inside the substrate, so failures here tend to take masonry and precast edges with
  them rather than staying a sealant problem.
* Most joint sealants have a minimum application temperature near 40 degrees, so with January lows
  around 18.4 degrees, cold-season work needs a low-temperature-rated product and dry, frost-free
  joints, not just a warm afternoon in the forecast.

Scoping

## Do you actually need this done?

The most expensive mistake is paying for the wrong scope. Here is how the usual symptoms sort out.

Common starting points. An on-site look is what settles it.

Process

## How the job runs
1. ### Survey and product selection
   
   Joints inspected and measured, substrates identified, and adhesion tested. Product is selected
   for movement capability and substrate compatibility, not for what is on the truck.
2. ### Mock-up and approval
   
   A sample run installed, cured, and hand pull-tested to confirm adhesion and primer requirements.
   Color is approved against the wall in daylight since cured color differs from the tube.
3. ### Access setup and protection
   
   Lift, stage, or rope access rigged, and sidewalks, glass, and landscaping protected. Tenants near
   the work get notice, particularly where windows must stay closed.
4. ### Cut out and clean
   
   Old sealant removed to sound substrate on both faces, joints cleaned by grinding or a two-cloth
   solvent wipe, and dust blown out. Joints are sealed the same day they are prepped.
5. ### Rod, prime, gun, and tool
   
   Backer rod set to depth, primer applied where required, sealant gunned and tooled to full contact
   on both joint faces. Tooling is what forces the hourglass profile that lets the joint move.
6. ### Cure, test, and close out
   
   Sealant cures for the product's stated period, then spot adhesion checks and any water testing.
   Close-out should include product data sheets, warranty documents, and a marked-up elevation of
   what was replaced.

Common questions

## Questions people ask

How often does commercial caulking need to be replaced?

It depends on the product. Standard polyurethane joint sealant typically gives seven to ten years in
exterior service. High-performance silicone commonly reaches fifteen to twenty. Exposure matters:
south and west elevations and joints in full sun fail first. Rather than replacing on a calendar,
most owners survey the envelope every few years and act when adhesion testing shows joints letting
go.

How much does it cost to recaulk a commercial building?

Published per-foot rates run roughly $4 to $12 for exterior wall joint replacement, $7 to $18 for
expansion joints, and $10 to $16 for window perimeters at elevated access. Total cost depends far
more on access than on footage: rigging a swing stage or renting a boom for a tall elevation can
exceed the sealant line. A real number requires a joint survey.

Can you caulk over old caulk?

Not on exterior joints that matter. New sealant can only be as sound as what it bonds to, and old
sealant that is failing takes the new layer with it. Proper replacement means cutting the old
material out to the substrate on both joint faces and cleaning the surfaces. Anyone quoting a
caulk-over on a building envelope is quoting a short-term cosmetic fix.

Silicone or polyurethane for building joints?

Silicone handles more movement, resists sunlight far better, and lasts longer, which is why it
dominates high-movement and glazing perimeter joints. Polyurethane is paintable, less prone to
staining porous stone, and cheaper. Choice comes down to expected joint movement, substrate, whether
the joint gets painted, and whether staining is a risk. A survey should name the product and the
reason.

Why did my new caulking fail so fast?

Usually one of four things: the old sealant was not fully removed, the substrate was not cleaned or
primed, no backer rod was used so the sealant bonded on three sides and could not stretch, or a
product with too little movement capability was chosen for the joint. All four look identical on day
one, which is why adhesion mock-ups and pull testing exist.

construction professionals. Products are sold through our authorized distribution network. We have
multiple branch locations throughout North America, and our products are available in overseas
markets as well.

Our products cover every facet of the construction industry – from protecting and sealing concrete,
expansion joints, and concrete restoration, to blocking the ingress of moisture through the building
envelope, we’re there.

We remain committed to producing high quality products and systems that meet or exceed the latest
EPA standards and guidelines.

Continuity is the secret of our company leadership and success
We’ve been a family-owned and operated company, serving the needs of the concrete construction
industry, since 1926.
